_contract: Written and COMMITTED before the measurement it predicts. A prediction recorded afterwards is an explanation, and this investigation exists because an explanation was mistaken for a measurement.
question: The four measured reports read 8 of the 67 items in calib.domain_balanced@v1. A formal search reads all 67. Does the FFN selection result survive the full mixture, or was it an artefact of the subsample?

reasoning_stated_in_advance.why_it_could_shrink: ffn_abs_sum is a SUM over tokens. With ~8x more tokens the sum grows ~8x while the accumulated reordering error grows only ~sqrt(8), so the RELATIVE drift should fall by roughly sqrt(8) ~ 2.8x. The cutoff margins are a property of the importance DISTRIBUTION; a better-estimated distribution does not systematically widen its relative gaps.
reasoning_stated_in_advance.why_it_should_survive_anyway: At 8 items the relative statistic drift is ~1e-03 on the parent against a minimum relative cutoff margin of ~2e-07 to ~8e-06 -- two to four orders of magnitude of headroom. Dividing the drift by 2.8 does not close a gap that size.

predicted._confidence: The direction is arithmetic and I am confident in it. The magnitudes are a guess, stated so they can be wrong.

what_would_falsify_the_consequence_claim: selection identical at every keep ratio and micro batch size on the full mixture -- in which case the 8-item numbers were a subsample artefact and the DECISION claim does not transfer to a formal search
a drop to a handful of layers, which would make the effect real but marginal at the scale C3 runs
_what_it_would_NOT_falsify: The root cause. A shape-dependent GEMM is a property of the kernel and the matrix shapes, not of how many calibration items are summed afterwards. K/N separating the exact projections from the divergent ones is unaffected by item count.
scope: Only statistics_decomposition and ffn_selection are rerun at 67 items. The case matrix and causal KL are not: batching 67 items into one [67, T, 151936] logit block is 41 GiB, and neither of them is what this variant asks.
